newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index rises 4.9 points to 826.6.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index rises 4.9 points to 826.6.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, rose 4.9 points on Monday to 826.6, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Four of the ten sectoral indices gained, with the chemistry index rising the most, up 1.33 percent to 449.4 points.
Six indices lost, with the investment fund index losing the most, down 1.78 percent to 1,058.5 points.
